card.name: Linking words before harm from contamination
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, being, to, is, that) right before an expected word like poisoning, illness or harm, in passages about polluted water, contamination or poisons. Also some digits in years within such passages.

modes.label: Link before contamination
modes.description: A small word like of, being or to sits just before a word about pollution or harm.
modes.example: there was too great a chance<< of>> it being polluted.

modes.label: Poison and dose sayings
modes.description: The word is or to just before a harm or poison term.
modes.example: the poison<< is>> in the dose."

modes.label: Digits in outbreak years
modes.description: A digit inside a year or percentage in water-disease text.
modes.example: Milwaukee had a huge outbreak of cryptosporidia in 1<<9>>93 that killed over 10

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like poison, poisoning and health as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words when the text is about to name poisoning or a health harm from bad water or toxins.
